svg.text: Moodle Assignment Checking Helper — how the components communicate
Who talks to whom, over which pathway, and what is transferred. Read from top to bottom: every numbered frame is one situation.
Content scripts, Popup ↔ Service worker: Chrome extension messages, and a status channel over which the service worker keeps sending its live statuses.
Popup → Content scripts: Chrome extension messages sent to the tabs.
Service worker ↔ VS Code background: WebSocket on 127.0.0.1:54321. Only the Chrome extension and other VS Code windows are let in.
VS Code background ↔ Webview: VS Code's webview messages.
Content scripts ↔ Moodle: the Moodle page itself, by reading its contents and filling in its fields.
Popup ↔ Definitions folder: the browser's folder access, read-only and with the lecturer's permission.
VS Code background ↔ Submissions folder: VS Code's workspace: files, editors and the terminal.
Content scripts of different tabs: a browser lock that lets only one Moodle tab grade at a time.
